cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Our family makes dumplings together whenever grandparents visit.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷奶奶一来，我们全家就一起包饺子。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: My father cooked noodles for us after the football match.
cards.example_zh: 足球赛后，爸爸给我们煮了面条。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: The broken window was my fault after the ball game.
cards.example_zh: 球赛之后，那扇打破的窗户是我的过错。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: I feel cold when the classroom windows stay open.
cards.example_zh: 教室窗户开着的时候，我觉得冷。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：建立；创立

cards.example_zh: 一些本地家庭下学期要创办一个音乐社团。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Visitors can still see gold in the old mine museum.
cards.example_zh: 游客仍能在旧矿博物馆里看到黄金。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Grandma packed dumplings for our early train this morning.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶今天早上为我们的早班火车包了饺子。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_zh: 我爷爷会讲有趣的故事。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：讨厌；憎恨
